description: This file defines the UrlResolver class in the Drupal media module, responsible for converting media URLs into oEmbed endpoint URLs, performing discovery, caching, and provider matching.

classes.name: UrlResolver
classes.description: Implements URL resolution for oEmbed media URLs, including discovery, provider matching, caching, and URL construction.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing dependencies: providers, resource fetcher, HTTP client, module handler, cache backend.

methods.name: discoverResourceUrl
methods.description: Discovers the oEmbed resource URL from a given URL via HTTP request and HTML parsing.

methods.name: findUrl
methods.description: Finds the oEmbed URL in a DOMXPath document for a specified format ('json' or 'xml').

methods.name: getProviderByUrl
methods.description: Identifies the oEmbed provider matching a given URL, or discovers it if not directly matched.

methods.name: getResourceUrl
methods.description: Retrieves the resource URL for a media item, utilizing cache and provider information, and constructs the URL with optional size parameters.

methods.name: getEndpointMatchingUrl
methods.description: Finds the appropriate endpoint URL for a media URL within a provider's endpoints.
